review: Friction curves show missing CEM cells as gaps, not fabricated values or passes. Single-cell data are descriptive, not a continuous robust interval.
Screen matrix P is only a core XY screen, never whole-task success. Nominal PPO-beta fails after4s despite core P; the plot states this distinction.
Selected topdowns retain shared absolute world limits and original timestamps. Pending panels are explicitly unavailable, not simulated or replayed as successful.

Additional low-mu strip has four horizontal panels, identical absolute scales/ticks/aspect, original0–6.98s paths and4s markers. Body/velocity directions and L/R axial wheel marks use a common legend.
Low-mu .01 nearly-straight trajectory is accompanied by max tilt124deg; it is not evidence of pure stable-contact understeer. Slow .05/.10 paths are distinguished from successful .15.
Faint wheel ticks indicate insufficient measured force-bearing contact at the displayed sample, not confirmed flight. Invalid projected wheel planes are skipped.
Height, flight, tilt, contact and beta do not gate failure. Desired beta is nonzero; beta error is against the reference and eligibility is disclosed.
No image is a new physics rollout, pose alignment, IK, path correction or policy training. Full38-case metric recomputation from compact native data exactly agrees.
